dict.Carburantul, reparațiile, asigurările și: Fuel, repairs, insurance and taxes for the company vehicles, with the document and the VAT: with mixed use you get 50% deductible VAT and 50% deductible expense, with business use only 100%; on the right the VAT to deduct and the non-deductible VAT, the deductible and non-deductible expenses and the total by type.
dict.Exclusiv pentru firmă se alege doar pent: Choose business use only just for vehicles with a logbook for every trip (Sheets → Mileage log) or for those covered by the legal exceptions (for example sales agents, transport, taxi).
dict.Folosința goală se socotește mixtă: la o: An empty use counts as mixed: for a vehicle also used privately only half of the VAT is deducted, and the expense (with the non-deducted VAT) is also deductible by half.
dict.Regulile și excepțiile se schimbă: verif: The rules and exceptions change: check with your accountant how the company vehicles are recorded.
